name: gauntlets
_design_note: F20-60 medium hand slot. Chain-and-leather construction — covers chain_gauntlets, iron_gauntlets, bronze_gauntlets in existing data.
lore_template: These {material_name} gauntlets, lined at the palm with leather, cover the hand and the first few inches of the forearm. They leave the fingers free enough to work a hilt, and they keep the knuckles whole in battle.
